pages.text: $(d)Lava Waders$() combine the effects of the $(l:irregular_implements:armor/obsidian_water_walking_boots)Obsidian Water Walking Boots$(/l) and the $(l:irregular_implements:items/lava_charm)Lava Charm$(/l), as well as allowing you to walk on Lava.$(br2)Get them by combining the two in an Anvil.
